'''Antal''' is a 4★ [[Electric]] [[Supporter]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. He is an [[Arts Unit]] user who can debuff targets and provide {{G|Amp|Amp}} to other teammates.

==Profile==
"A mission for me? Good. I happen to be seeking field-testing opportunities for modified orbiters."<br/>A member of [[Operations Team Z7]] in Endfield, Antal works as a supporter and an [[Originium]] technology consultant. He is clever and quick on the uptake, but not the best at reading people. More than once he has dropped comments so out of place they leave the rest of the team groaning. Even so, his talent for Originium Arts is remarkable, though he himself seems hardly aware of it.<br/>Influenced by his grandmother, Antal has little concern for conventional success and pours all his focus into whatever fascinates him. Be it an Originium device he has never seen before or a dry joke that leaves him marveling, this young Savra won't rest for days until he feels he has unraveled its secrets.<br/>"Curiously, your presence greatly amplifies my eagerness to share my vast knowledge."
